page.overview:
What is Zhenyuan Daxian?

Zhenyuan has the body of a young boy, the face of a woman, and a flowing beard and mustache. He wore a purple-gold cap, a gown trimmed with a trim of crane downfeathers, a silk sash tied around his waist, and a pair of shoes. Crow feathers adorned his hair.

Zhenyuan is ancient, even by the standards of an immortal. He has guided countless apprentices to the status of immortal over the years.

Zhenyuan and his immortal apprentices were invited up to Heaven by the Celestial Worthy of the Primordial Beginning to attend the discourse. He left the Five Villages Abbey in the care of two young apprentices while he was gone, as he knew Tang Sanzang and his disciples were to arrive soon.

When he and his apprentices returned to Five Villages Abbey, they found it in disarray. He easily dispelled a sleep spell put on his two apprentices, who explained that Sun Wukong had toppled his precious Ginseng Fruit Tree and fled.
